general.confirmDeleteDescription: Ask before deleting groups or saved windows
general.openOnClickDescription: Single click opens tab in browser
general.dedupDescription: Remove duplicate tabs when merging windows
general.previewImagesDescription: Hovering a tab sends its address to fetch a page image. Not stored or linked to you.
general.staleDescription: Show amber dot on tabs older than this
general.urlRulesDescription: Auto-assign newly-opened tabs to a group by URL pattern

data.intro: TabMerger stores all data locally in IndexedDB. Cloud sync requires a Pro account.
data.exportDescription: Download all groups as a JSON file
data.importDescription: Restore groups from a JSON export
data.importDescription_one: The {{count}} group in "{{file}}" will be added next to the groups you already have.
data.importDescription_other: The {{count}} groups in "{{file}}" will be added next to the groups you already have.

ai.intro: Every AI action below draws from the same monthly AI quota (see Account tab). Turn off features you don't use to save quota for the ones you do.
ai.nameGroupDescription: Suggest a name for a group with AI
ai.suggestSessionsDescription: Background banner suggesting when to save a session
ai.summariesDescription: AI summary on tab hover preview
ai.throttleLabel: Limit automatic AI suggestions to once a day
ai.throttleDescription: The background suggest-sessions banner fires at most once per day to protect your monthly AI quota. AI actions you trigger manually (Auto-group, Name group, Organize) are never limited by this.

dev.demoDescription: Seed sample data for the marketing demo pipeline
dev.usageDescription: Sets the AI credit counter (out of {{cap}}) locally and syncs it to your real Supabase account, so server-side quota enforcement can be tested end-to-end.
dev.sentryDescription: Throw a test error to verify reporting

toast.encryptionReset: Encryption reset — set up a new passphrase
toast.signInForAiUsage: Sign in to sync AI usage to the server
toast.aiUsageFailed: Failed to sync AI usage to server
toast.previewImagesDenied: Firefox needs permission to fetch page images. Allow it in the browser's prompt to turn this on.
